authorityBinding.bindingRule: The independent review pins the authority, both tokens, consumer and validator. The external receipt pins the committed carrier artifacts and exact clean worktree; this token cannot self-pin or bypass either gate.

orderedSteps: consume this token only after the exact clean receipt validates
author canonical v63 semantics and deterministic generator/test compatibility within the exact allowlist
run the contracts generator exactly once and the fixture writer only when deterministic fixture closure changes
verify immutable v1 through v62 lineage and exact v63 counts, routes, predicate, People projection and default-OFF state
author V273 only after the generated v63 checksum is final
run only the bounded generator, Auth, Gateway and migration checks
commit one non-merge direct child of the exact base, independently review it, then push only this lane branch
requiredOutcomes: One immutable product-surfaces v63 DRAFT successor over byte-identical v62.

V273 declares only the v63 checksum, catalog-only Goal resource and duties, default-OFF HRIS_PER_GOAL_COMMANDS feature and two route bindings.
There are zero automatic-import, activation, enrollment, role-assignment, principal-grant or business-data effects.
The generated People v63 projection remains unmounted and runtime remains bound to v60.

repository, worktree realpath, branch, HEAD, tree and origin/dwp-dev

verification.rerunPolicy: After a failure rerun only the smallest affected target. Repository-wide execution is forbidden.

forbidden: People PER-009 handler, persistence, runtime PEP or Performance V21 implementation
frontend, sidebar, menu, route or page work
automatic bundle import, feature activation, tenant enrollment, assignment or principal grant
